# Class: StudyTemplate 


_One kind of study the layout accounts for. A template is a *specialisation*: it names the entries a kind adds to the study every kind already shares, and nothing else. The general study is therefore not a template and names none — a kind earns an entry here only once some directory or file genuinely belongs to it and not to the rest._
